text:
Alyssa (partnerships): Quick sync — we need signoff on localized press blurbs + SI partner mention for the marketplace landing. Legal needs final copy, localization window is Tue–Wed next week. @Jordan can you confirm hero line and 1-liner by EOD?
Jordan (marketing): Yep, I can have hero + 1-liner by 5pm. Do we have finalized partner names for SI callouts?
Alyssa (partnerships): For launch callout we want three: Nimbus Systems (HW SI), CloudBridge (cloud SI), and OrbitWorks (integration partner). Confirmed with partners for co-announcement but legal requested exact phrasing.
Michael (legal): Ok — send the exact lines you intend to publish. I need to review for trademark/brand usage and any customer mentions. Keep it to brand-level (no claims like "powered by") unless partners approved.
Rita (solutions): Heads-up: OrbitWorks asked for a short note about SSO support. If we include that, we need to sync on technical wording. Prefer: "supports SAML-based SSO via OrbitWorks connector" — is that fine?
Ken (product): That phrasing is ok. Avoid implying deep managed integration — "connector" + "supports" is accurate.
Jordan (marketing): Draft hero + blurb below — can legal review?
```
Hero: "Redwood Marketplace — production-ready inference, now with vetted SI partners"
1-liner: "Find certified integrations and HW-accelerated bundles from strategic partners to deploy Redwood Inference faster and with predictable economics."
Partner callout (OrbitWorks): "OrbitWorks connector enables SAML SSO for streamlined sign-on to Redwood deployments."
```
Michael (legal): Reviewing now. Two quick asks: (1) change "certified" to "verified" unless you have certification artifacts, (2) avoid "predictable economics" — ok to say "predictable performance and cost controls".
Jordan (marketing): Got it — I'll switch "certified" -> "verified" and tweak.
Alyssa (partnerships): Localization: we need translations for EN/FR/DE/JA. Localization team can start once copy is final. Target: translations back by Mon COB so we can QA Tue.
Rita (solutions): SI logos — partners provided SVGs. Legal wants logo usage terms before we publish. Michael?
Michael (legal): I'll attach standard logo permission text in a sec. For OrbitWorks we still need a signed logo release — Alyssa, are we tracking that?
Alyssa (partnerships): Yes, OrbitWorks release is pending; Nimbus & CloudBridge are done. I'll ping OrbitWorks again today.
Jordan (marketing): Landing page checklist for dev/ops: assets (SVGs + retina png), localized copy (4 langs), press blurbs, GA tag, press embargo meta. Can we get a deploy target? @deploy-bot any ETA for staging cut?
deploy-bot: Staging slot booked Thu 09:00 UTC. Push window is Thu 09:00-11:00. CI job: `marketplace/landing-deploy`.
Ken (product): Can we include an A/B test for hero CTA? Variant A: "Explore verified partners" Variant B: "Browse integrations" — small experiment to measure click-through.
Jordan (marketing): Happy to run A/B. Need dev flag + GA event names. Ken can you create the experiment ticket?
Ken (product): Created ticket PROD-1248, devs assigned.
Michael (legal): Quick note on press embargo: partners may want a 48-hour embargo. If so we need coordination with PR and partner timelines. Alyssa, confirm embargo windows per partner.
Alyssa (partnerships): OrbitWorks asked for embargo until Friday 14:00 PST, Nimbus is fine with immediate, CloudBridge wants a short notice but no embargo. I'll consolidate and confirm by EOD.
Jordan (marketing): Thanks — I'll draft the press email and embargo schedule once you confirm. Also prepping blog outline + byline suggestions.
Rita (solutions): For SI playbook links on the landing, can we point to partner-hosted docs or prefer a Redwood-hosted summary? Partners prefer links to their docs but legal asked for a short Redwood summary first.
Michael (legal): Redwood-hosted summary + partner link is best for compliance. Keep host summaries factual and link to partner T&Cs for specifics.
Alyssa (partnerships): Next steps: Jordan finalize copy by 5pm; Michael do legal signoff by 10pm; Alyssa to chase OrbitWorks logo release; localization to start once final copy is posted; deploy Thu 09:00 UTC. If anything slips we push to next cycle. :thumbsup:
Jordan (marketing): On it. Thanks team! :rocket:
Rita (solutions): I'll prepare a short tech note for the landing (1 paragraph) and drop in the doc.
Alyssa (partnerships): Perfect — closing loop here. I'll post a follow-up thread with embargo matrix once OrbitWorks confirms.
Jordan (marketing): FYI — preview link for design mock: https://redwood.example/marketplace/preview (access: partners@redwood.example)
Alyssa (partnerships): Awesome. If anyone hits blockers ping me in DM.
Michael (legal): Signing off on the revised phrasing. Send me the final copy before push.
Ken (product): Noted. See PROD-1248 for experiment details.
deploy-bot: Reminder: CI job `marketplace/landing-deploy` must pass smoke tests 30m before window.
Alyssa (partnerships): Great — thanks everyone, closing this thread once embargo matrix posted.
